contexts.text: The Moravians think of the Lord as the Arians do.
They would have made themselves Socinians, or Arians, and thus would have destroyed the whole Church.
Have not Socinianism and Arianism sprung from the thought of God as of three Persons?
Wherefore they who deny the Divine in His Human are not far from the Socinians and Arians...
The damnable heresy of Arius... TCR 174.
Arius and his partizans are in the deep.
This deed was done by Arius and his followers...
(Character of the Arian and Socinian faith.)

The two wicked heresies, the Arian and the Socinian... These abominations still lie hidden in the general spirit of the men of the Church at this day... Such are in fellowship with the Arians and Socinians who are in Hell.
(Arius likened to the serpent sent forth from Hell into the garden of God.)
Arius reigns clandestinely to the end.
They who, like the Arians, have denied the Divinity of the Lord's Human, come among these (in Hell) after death.
Hence the Socinians and Arians are not of Heaven.
